about: Option A of D5: each option carries example objects (the Laya model card recommends detailed criteria). The phone's Core ML export takes at most 96 tokens per question, state included, so choice options carry two short examples each; true/false sides carry a short description. Examples are everyday objects that appear nowhere in validation.json and are not game words, so a pass cannot come from matching the answer key.
